strings.en: To the round of 64
Ad test mode
No ad available.
So you're a pro? Let me try a round.
The rumors were true. Next time, I'll win.
Maybe I should go pro too!
A pro joined us? Let's test those rumors.

strings.ko: 소문날 만하네. 다음 판은 내 거야.
strings.en: Those rumors make sense. Next round is mine.

strings.ko: 소문보다 내가 더 센 것 같은데?
strings.en: Looks like I beat the rumors.
Even pros leave openings. I'll find yours.
No opening this time. I'll find one next round.
Found it: a pro's weak spot!
Let's see your strategy against mine.
Good strategy. Next time, I'll read your moves.

strings.ko: 이번 작전은 내가 한 수 위였네.
strings.en: My plan was one move ahead.

strings.ko: 여기서 내가 제일 센데, 프로는 다를까?
strings.en: I'm the best here. Can a pro change that?
You took my top spot. I'll win it back.
I'm still the one to beat around here!

strings.ko: 프로라고 서두를 건 없지. 한 판 해볼까?
strings.en: No rush, pro. Shall we play a round?
Cool under pressure. I'll connect first next time.
A steady game can beat a pro too.

strings.ko: 몇 수 앞까지 봐? 나랑 한번 겨뤄보자.
strings.en: How many moves ahead can you see? Let's play.

strings.ko: 더 멀리 봤군. 다음엔 내가 앞서간다.
strings.en: You saw further. I'll get ahead next time.

strings.ko: 프로보다 한 수 더 봤나 보네.
strings.en: Looks like I saw one move further.

strings.ko: 오래 둔 경험도 만만치 않아. 붙어볼까?
strings.en: Years of play count for something. Ready?

strings.ko: 경험만으론 안 되네. 다음엔 다를 거야.
strings.en: Experience wasn't enough. Next time will be different.
Experience wins this kind of game.
My turn to challenge the pro, right?

strings.ko: 도전할 맛 나네. 다음엔 내가 이긴다.
strings.en: Now that's a challenge. Next time, I'll win.
Glad I challenged you. I beat the pro!
Let us test both experience and instinct.
A good move. I will study that.
My instincts were right this time.
Let us put the fundamentals to the test.

strings.ko: 기본 위에 한 수를 더 쌓았군.
strings.en: You built one move beyond the basics.
Solid fundamentals won this round.
Are you reading the next move?
You were a move ahead of my prediction.
The next move went as I expected.

strings.ko: 두 방향을 동시에 지킬 수 있겠나?
strings.en: Can you defend two directions at once?
You read both directions.
One defense left another path open.
Let us test your balance of attack and defense.
You kept your balance to the end.
I found the gap in your balance.
I will not overlook a small opening.
You left no opening.
A small opening decided the game.
Read the whole board before deciding.
You changed the flow of the board.
The board was flowing my way.
You are close to the final challenge.
The final challenger is waiting for you.

strings.ko: 마지막 관문까지는 아직 한 수 남았군.
strings.en: One more step before the final challenge.
Show me you can beat the division commander.
An excellent game. You have won.
The final round is mine.

strings.ko: 아… 역시 잘하네. 한 판 더 해 줄래?
strings.en: You really are good. Can we play again?

strings.ko: 내가 이겼어? 야, 나 지금 손 떨려!
strings.en: I won? My hands are still shaking!

strings.ko: 프로 왔다며? 나랑도 한 판 하자!
strings.en: A pro joined us? Come on, play me!
Wow, you can play! No wonder everyone talks.
Everyone in the barracks is hearing about this!

strings.ko: 어제 네 경기 봤어. 오늘은 나랑 하자.
strings.en: I watched you yesterday. My turn today.

strings.ko: 졌네. 끝나고 어떻게 이겼는지 알려 줘.
strings.en: You got me. Show me how you did that later.
Watching yesterday paid off.

strings.ko: 쉬는 시간이니까 부담 갖지 말고 해.
strings.en: We are on break. Just enjoy the game.

strings.ko: 오, 잠 다 깼다. 너 꽤 하는데?
strings.en: Well, I am awake now. You are good!
I may look sleepy, but I was watching.

strings.ko: 프로라고 들었다. 어디 실력 좀 볼까?
strings.en: I hear you were a pro. Let us see you play.

strings.ko: 잘하네. 소문이 괜히 난 게 아니었어.
strings.en: Well played. You earned that reputation.

strings.ko: 이번엔 내가 이겼군. 다시 해 보자.
strings.en: This one is mine. Let us try again.

strings.ko: 공군 대표로 왔는데, 그냥 질 순 없지.
strings.en: I am here for the Air Force. I cannot just lose!
Is everyone in the Army this good?
I won! I have a story to take back with me.

strings.ko: 표정이 왜 그래? 편하게 해, 편하게.
strings.en: Why so tense? Relax and enjoy it.
Ha! You beat me fair and square.
Ha! Looks like this one is mine.

strings.ko: 서두를 것 없다. 천천히 보고 둬.
strings.en: No rush. Think it through.
Well done. You stayed focused to the end.
Seems I can still win a game or two.

strings.ko: 나도 이거 꽤 오래 했는데. 해 볼까?
strings.en: I have played this for years. Shall we?
Well! Someone finally outplayed me.
All those years paid off.

strings.ko: 어제 혼자 연습했어. 오늘은 좀 다를걸?
strings.en: I practiced yesterday. Today might be different!

strings.ko: 아쉽다. 연습 좀 더 하고 올게.
strings.en: So close. I need more practice.
Yes! Glad I practiced.

strings.ko: 우리 소대에 프로가 왔다는데, 그냥 지나칠 수 있나.
strings.en: A pro in my platoon? I had to play you.
Nice! I should tell the company commander.

strings.ko: 오늘은 내가 이겼네. 다음엔 설욕해 봐.
strings.en: My win today. Come back for a rematch.

strings.ko: 소대장이 자네 얘기를 하도 해서 와 봤네.
strings.en: Your platoon leader kept talking about you.

strings.ko: 좋아, 한 판 더 하세. 이대로 끝내기는 아쉽군.
strings.en: Another game! We cannot stop here.

strings.ko: 이번엔 내가 이겼군. 자네랑 두니 재밌어.
strings.en: My win this time. Playing you is fun.

strings.ko: 한 판 지고 물러날 순 없지. 다시 해 보자고.
strings.en: I cannot walk away after one loss. Again!
Two losses. I have to admit it: you are good!

strings.ko: 이번 판은 내가 가져갔네. 다음에 또 하자고.
strings.en: This one is mine. Let us play again sometime.

strings.ko: 작전 회의 끝나자마자 왔네. 한 판 괜찮겠나?
strings.en: Just finished the briefing. Have time for a game?

strings.ko: 이런, 내가 졌군. 한 판 더 부탁하네.
strings.en: You got me. Another game, please.

strings.ko: 오늘은 내가 이겼군. 생각할 게 많은 경기였어.
strings.en: My win today. That gave me a lot to think about.

strings.ko: 아까는 내가 너무 복잡하게 생각했군. 다시 해 보세.
strings.en: I overthought that one. Let us try again.

strings.ko: 또 졌군. 다음엔 더 준비하고 오겠네.
strings.en: Lost again. I will come better prepared next time.

strings.ko: 이번엔 통했군. 덕분에 머리 좀 썼네.
strings.en: That worked. You made me think.

strings.ko: 훈련병 때부터 이름을 들었네. 드디어 만나보는군.
strings.en: I have heard of you since training. At last we meet.

strings.ko: 실력이 좋군. 한 판 더 해 보겠나?
strings.en: You play well. Care for another?
This time I won. Well played.

strings.ko: 아까는 깔끔하게 졌네. 이번에도 봐주지 말게.
strings.en: You beat me cleanly. Do not go easy this time either.

strings.ko: 두 판 다 졌군. 소문보다 더 잘하네.
strings.en: Both games lost. Better than the rumors said.
Evened the score. Keep giving me your best.

strings.ko: 연대까지 소문이 났더군. 직접 보고 싶었네.
strings.en: The whole regiment has heard. I wanted to see for myself.

strings.ko: 과연 잘하는군. 한 판만 더 해 보세.
strings.en: You really can play. Just one more.

strings.ko: 내가 이겼군. 그래도 쉽게 끝나진 않았어.
strings.en: My win. You did not make it easy.

strings.ko: 한 판으로 끝내긴 아쉽군. 조금 더 해 보세.
strings.en: One game is not enough. Let us play another.
Today belongs to you. Well done.

strings.ko: 이번엔 내가 이겼네. 다음에 또 찾아오게.
strings.en: My win this time. Come play again.

strings.ko: 내가 졌다고 소문내지는 말게. 아직 시작도 안 했지만!
strings.en: Keep it quiet if I lose. We have not even started yet!

strings.ko: 허허, 졌네! 한 판 더 하면 안 되겠나?
strings.en: Ha! You got me. Could we play another?

strings.ko: 허허, 아직은 내가 이길 때도 있군!
strings.en: Ha! I still win sometimes!

strings.ko: 허허, 정말 졌네. 이번엔 좀 더 버텨 보겠어.
strings.en: Ha, I really did lose. I will last longer this time.

strings.ko: 두 번이나 졌군. 이젠 소문내도 되겠어!
strings.en: Beaten twice! Now you can tell everyone!
This one is mine. That was fun.

strings.ko: 부대가 자네 덕에 시끌시끌하더군. 나도 끼워 주게.
strings.en: You have got the whole unit talking. Let me join in.

strings.ko: 내가 졌군. 한 판 더 두어 보세.
strings.en: You beat me. Let us play another.
I won this one. Well played.

strings.ko: 즐겁군. 마지막으로 한 판 더 부탁하네.
strings.en: This is fun. One last game, if you will.

strings.ko: 잘했네! 사단 병사 대회가 열리니, 자네도 나가 보게.
strings.en: Well done! Enter our upcoming division tournament for enlisted soldiers.

strings.ko: 오늘 경기는 여기까지 하세. 다음에 또 오게.
strings.en: That is enough for today. Come back sometime.

strings.ko: 64강부터 너야? 이번엔 나도 연습 많이 했어!
strings.en: You, in the first round? I practiced a lot this time!
Lost again. I did better this time though, right?
I won! That means I made the last 32, right?

strings.ko: 또 만났네! 오늘 지는 사람 응원 담당이다.
strings.en: You again! The loser gets cheering duty today.

strings.ko: 알았다, 응원은 내가 할게. 꼭 우승해!
strings.en: All right, I will cheer. Go win the whole thing!

strings.ko: 응원 크게 해라! 나 더 올라간다!
strings.en: Cheer loud! I am going all the way!

strings.ko: 지난번에 지고 계속 생각났어. 오늘은 다를 거야.
strings.en: I kept thinking about that loss. Today will be different.

strings.ko: 또 졌네. 결승에서 네가 이기는 건 꼭 봐야겠다.
strings.en: Lost again. Now I have to see you win the final.

strings.ko: 드디어 이겼네. 이제 마음이 좀 놓인다.
strings.en: Finally beat you. What a relief.
Quarterfinals already. Better stay awake for this.
Well played. Go win for both of us.
Whew. My turn to advance.
Our first game together. Good luck.
You are through. Good luck in the final.
Good game. I will do my best in the final.

strings.ko: 결승에서 만나네. 이번엔 진짜 안 질 거야!
strings.en: We meet in the final. I am not losing this time!

strings.ko: 졌어. 우승 축하해! 그래도 다음엔 내가 이긴다.
strings.en: You won. Congratulations! Next time is mine though.

strings.ko: 내가 우승이야? 야, 나 진짜 해냈다!
strings.en: I won the tournament? I actually did it!
Division enlisted tournament champion!

strings.ko: 이 게임의 프로라고 했지? 그런데 내가 이길 것 같아.
strings.en: You said you were a pro at this game? I think I can beat you.

strings.ko: 프로는 역시 다르네. 다음엔 내가 이긴다.
strings.en: A pro really is different. Next time, I win.
Was that pro story just a bluff?
